items.title: Prep: Cook Dried Beans
items.notes: Soak a small amount of dry black beans Tuesday. Cook them Tuesday evening or Wednesday morning. About 3/4 cup dry makes the 1.5 cups the brownies need.

items.title: Prep: Easy Overnight Oats
items.notes: Mix Thursday's oats Wednesday night with the buttermilk kefir.

items.title: Prep: Fresh-Milled Bread Machine Loaf
items.notes: One loaf only, from Wednesday's enhancer bucket. Mill 5 cups of wheat. Add one scoop of mix (about 1 1/2 cups until the jar label says otherwise), 1 1/2 cups water, and 2 tsp yeast. No egg. Whole wheat cycle, 2 lb. Check the dough in the first 5–10 minutes.

items.title: Prep: Homemade Mayo (Don't Waste the Crumbs)
items.notes: Only if Monday's keto salad finished the open mayo. One small batch. Eggs, oil, and lemon juice are on hand.

items.title: Prep: Bread Machine Pizza Dough
items.notes: Start the dough Sunday afternoon.

items.title: Dinner: Mom's Taco Salad
items.notes: Already underway. Half a head of romaine, one salad kit if the head looks small, and 1 lb of the beef. Mayo is for the separate keto salad, not this. Open sardines are the evening snack, not part of dinner.

items.title: Breakfast: Basic Preparation Instructions for Creamy Wheat Farina Hot Cereal
items.notes: The one box of cream of wheat. Another box is already on the buy list and is not for this breakfast.

items.title: Dinner: Honey Dijon Chicken
items.notes: Two chicken breasts, not four. Finish one partial Dijon jar. Honey from the cupboard above the microwave. A pinch of savory in the glaze. Plates are filled out with penne and the 14.5 oz Alfredo jar, plus the leftover dashi soup and salmon skin. Frozen broccoli on the side. Parmesan is only a tiny bit, so sprinkle what is left on the pasta.

items.title: Breakfast: Black Bean Brownies
items.notes: About 1.5 cups cooked black beans from the dry beans, a spoon of cocoa, and honey from the microwave cupboard. Half a cup of the accessible oatmeal, blended, because quick oats are out of the bins. Chocolate chips only if a bag is already in the house.

items.title: Dinner: Turkey Chili
items.notes: 1 lb ground turkey plus about 1/2 cup dry TVP, rehydrated, so the chili still feeds six. One portion of the kidney beans, the diced tomatoes, and some tomato paste. Skip cannellini and pinto unless those cans are actually on the shelf. Chili powder and cumin are on hand. This is the TVP trial, not a plan to finish the whole bag.

items.title: Snack: Fresh-Milled Bread Machine Loaf
items.notes: Enhancer bucket only. Do not mill flour and do not start the machine. Mix and label a jar for 7 loaves: 3 1/2 cups powdered milk, 1 3/4 cups potato flakes, 1 3/4 cups sugar, 3 1/2 Tbsp salt, 7/8 cup vital wheat gluten, and butter powder equal to 1 3/4 cups butter. Measure the finished volume, divide by 7, and write that scoop on the jar. If powdered milk, potato flakes, or butter powder is short, mix only as many loaves as the smallest jar allows.

items.title: Breakfast: Easy Overnight Oats
items.notes: Mix Wednesday night. Liquid is the buttermilk kefir, with plain kefir or the last of the milk if the jars need more. Make only as many jars as the accessible oatmeal allows. Chia and a little honey.

items.title: Dinner: Tikka Masala Pouches with Turkey
items.notes: 1 lb of the remaining ground turkey, one tikka pouch, and couscous. That leaves two tikka pouches and the coconut curry pouch. Toppings for texture: shredded cabbage, the half bag of spinach, diced onion, shredded carrot, Monday's roasted pumpkin seeds, and a spoon of plain kefir. Add bottled chickpeas if that jar is still there. Frozen green beans only if the plate still looks bare.

items.title: Breakfast: 3-Ingredient Vegan Banana Oat Pancakes
items.notes: Use the two hands of bananas. The recipe batch is small, so repeat until the bananas are gone or the accessible oats run out. Eggs on the side if the oats run out first.

items.title: Dinner: Egg Salad Wraps - Vagabonding
items.notes: 12 eggs on the one loaf baked Friday from the enhancer bucket. A few flour tortillas are not enough for wraps. Mustard instead of the skosh of relish. Mayo is probably gone after Monday's keto salad, so make a small batch Thursday if the jar is empty. A quarter cup is enough.

items.title: Snack: Practice Gingerbread Slab
items.notes: First laser-practice slab, baked Friday afternoon so it can cool and dry overnight. One batch only. Cheap dough: whole wheat flour, a quarter cup of oil instead of butter, a quarter cup of the blackstrap already open, a little brown sugar, one egg, ginger, and pumpkin pie spice. No icing. Engrave Saturday once it is cool. Do not serve it if the laser also cuts wood or plastic.

items.title: Breakfast: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
items.notes: Morning is the unmixed pumpkin pastries: mix the filling and bake them. Cookies can follow once the oven is free, or during the afternoon. Cookies need about 1 cup puree and ground cinnamon. If cinnamon is not home yet, use pumpkin pie spice. Chocolate chips only if they are already in the house. The pumpkin fruit leather can go into the cookies if it is still there. Engrave Friday's cooled gingerbread slab whenever the oven is busy. Mix a second slab only if the first one was too soft, too dark, or broke, and change just one thing.

items.title: Dinner: Cabbage Beef Skillet
items.notes: Stovetop, so the oven can stay on pastries and cookies. The last half pound of beef, shredded cabbage, carrots, garlic, and soy. Not pumpkin soup.

items.title: Breakfast: German Pancakes
items.notes: Third Sunday of November, so German pancakes. Flour and the syrup above the microwave are on hand. Eggs are on hand. Milk is only half a gallon, so this assumes the milk buy has happened.

items.title: Dinner: Bread Machine Pizza Dough
items.notes: Homemade pizza. Yeast and whole wheat flour are on hand. Sauce from a can of tomato sauce. Pepperoni is 1 lb 5 oz, so do not buy more. Buy mozzarella unless a bag turns up before Sunday. Other toppings already here: mushrooms, artichoke hearts, green olives, onion.
